title: A Hybrid AI Framework for Academic Advising: Integrating Ensemble-Based Grade Prediction and a Rule-Based Expert System
abstract: arXiv:2609.26243v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapidly increasing student population has posed serious challenges to the traditional academic advising process. This study designs and implements a multi-purpose intelligent system to support students' academic progress, based on a two-part hybrid framework: (1) an advanced model for grade prediction and (2) a rule-based recommendation engine. Using a dataset containing 416,558 educational records from the University of Birjand, students were first divided into homogeneous clusters using the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM). Subsequently, a Stacking Ensemble model combining Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and MLP was trained specifically for each cluster. Evaluation results demonstrated that the Stacking model outperformed base models across all clusters, achieving a final aggregated RMSE of 2.35. The second component is an expert system that provides intelligent recommendations by synergizing educational regulations with the grades

translated_title: 一种用于学业指导的混合人工智能框架：集成基于集成学习的成绩预测与基于规则的专家系统
translated_abstract: 快速增长的学生人数给传统的学业指导流程带来了严峻挑战。本研究设计并实现了一个多功能智能系统，以支持学生的学业进步，该系统基于一个由两部分组成的混合框架：（1）先进的成绩预测模型和（2）基于规则的推荐引擎。使用包含比尔詹德大学416,558条教育记录的数据集，首先利用高斯混合模型（GMM）将学生划分为同质聚类。随后，针对每个聚类专门训练了结合随机森林、梯度提升和多层感知机（MLP）的Stacking集成模型。评估结果表明，Stacking模型在所有聚类中的表现均优于基础模型，最终达到了2.35的总体均方根误差（RMSE）。第二个组件是一个专家系统，通过将教育法规与学生成绩协同结合来提供智能推荐。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种混合AI框架，将基于聚类的Stacking集成成绩预测模型（RMSE达2.35）与基于规则的专家系统相结合，为学业指导提供智能支持。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a hybrid AI framework that combines a cluster-based Stacking ensemble grade prediction model (achieving an RMSE of 2.35) with a rule-based expert system to provide intelligent academic advising support.
